title: pimpinella alpestris
intro: Pimpinella alpestris, commonly known as Alpine Bishop's Hat or Alpine Burnet, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. It is a perennial herb that is native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. The health benefits of Pimpinella alpestris include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body.
